title: Otori Emu — Quack ☆ A Ducky Endeavor!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whew... I did it! Three sets of squats!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (My legs always wobbled before, but I feel fine today.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get the hang of the Phoenix Stage's training regimen!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But doing strength exercises all by myself sort of isn't fun... I should've asked the others to join me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But the audition just ended...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Tsukasa went a few days without food just to figure out his character. That must've been so hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Yes...
You... You were always so mean, but also kind...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You were willing to become my very first friend...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'm sorry, Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'm so sorry...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Tsukasa was so amazing!
Even more amazing than during the workshop...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I need to keep doing my best too...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, we're celebrating the 30th anniversary of the Phoenix Stage!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (For the sake of all our guests who love and adore Phoenix Wonderland, we gotta make it a really amazing show!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, it's the 30th anniversary, so I'll do thirty laps of the park!
Ah, Emu, hello.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui! Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Were you practicing by yourself just now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ What about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The same. Nene asked me to join her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was gonna run on my own, but I wasn't sure if I'd be able to get through my workout.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Hehe. What a convenience!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe she meant a “coincidence”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Yeah, that works too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do you mean, “That works too”...?
Also, how does your mind land on that word first?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, we're going to get cold if we just stand around like this, so let's start running...
Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't know you'd all be here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Tsukasa's here! Another convenience☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: C-Convenience?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You know it's okay to take it easy for a while, right, Tsukasa? We know how hard it was for you to figure out your character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's the opposite! If I don't keep practicing, I may lose my grasp on what I learned!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, so you wish to keep working on your role?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan...
As for all of you... Hm? Were you about to work out together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If so, I'd like to warm up with you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then! Once we're done with our run, let's head over to the Wonder Stage to practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds good since we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
So, let's run!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You guys ready?!
Thirty laps to celebrate the 30th anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Thirty?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Emu, wait! You didn't tell us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go♪
